mentions.name: MergeMonkey
mentions.description: A GitHub app that provides intentionally quiet AI-powered pull request reviews. It runs on new commits, posts a short structured summary (including diagrams for complex changes), and only goes deeper when explicitly triggered via PR comments. Users bring their own model through OpenRouter, choosing their own trade-offs.
mentions.problem: Avoids noisy AI code reviews and black-box reviewer behavior.
mentions.audience: People who review pull requests regularly.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on a small GitHub app called MergeMonkey.
